newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE shares move higher in the week.
newsitem.headline: UAE shares move higher in the week.

text.p: Stocks on the informal United Arab Emirates market edged higher in the week to Thursday, with the index gaining half a percent, brokers said.
The National Bank of Abu Dhabi (NBAD) 27-share index ended the week almost 13 points higher at 2,360.29 points.
Shares of 10 companies rose and the rest were unchanged.
Trade focused on Dubai Investment Co and Emirates International Bank, brokers said.
Dubai Investment Co inched up half a dirham to 15 and Al-Dhafra Insurance rose to 780 from 770 dirhams last week.
Telecommunications company Etisalat was up five dirhams at 940. Emirates Insurance also moved ahead five dirhams to 580.
In the banking sector, Abu Dhabi National Bank was up at 412 dirhams from 410 and Union National Bank gained 10 to 310.
Abu Dhabi Shipbuilding Co shares were up at 33 dirhams from 32 the previous week.
